title: an-iou-notices-when-its-physics-arrives
intention: An IOU names what it is waiting for in a checkable way, so that when that physics lands the IOU reds as STALE instead of reading forever as 'not built yet'.
why: An IOU is defined by Law 4 as a TRACKED debt, and nothing tracks whether the debt is still owed. Measured 2026-09-09: 11 of 100 IOU sites in class-space were stale — the physics they wait on had already landed. Nine skill charters said 'IOU until cairnmap is built'; cairnmap is built and its --gate reds with 21 findings nobody had looked at, because the stale prose was a standing reason not to look.
how: Today an IOU is prose with no referent a machine can re-ask. Give the IOU a declared dependency — a path, a command, or a cast ticket id — and a sieve that re-asks it: if the named thing now resolves (the file exists, the command exits 0, the ticket reads PROVED) the IOU is stale and reds until it is either scrubbed or re-worded. First cut: extend cairn/machines/corrosion/constraint_set.json, which already declares the Rules-awaiting-physics section as a constraint set, and add a sieve to build_inspector beside constraint_enforcement_holds. The 11 stale sites measured this session are the fixture corpus.
traces_to: Law 4 — 'a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy — until it is, it is a tracked debt (an IOU), not a resting state.' The law says an IOU is a TRACKED debt; nothing tracks whether the debt is still owed. Also Law 1 (re-deriving a settled answer is a defect: nine charters re-assert 'cairnmap is not built' against a built cairnmap) and Law 9 (an IOU whose physics landed is a component reading as whatever it last said about itself).
falsifier: DONE when every IOU in class-space carries a checkable dependency referent and a sieve reds any whose referent now resolves; and when the 11 sites measured stale on 2026-09-09 are either scrubbed or red. WRONG INTENT if the referent field lands but nobody fills it honestly — a corpus of IOUs whose declared dependency is unresolvable prose is the same defect wearing a schema. The measurement is the count of IOUs whose referent a machine can actually re-ask, not the count of IOUs carrying the field.
constraints: Only DECLARED IOUs are in scope: CLAUDE.md's Rules-awaiting-physics entries and a charter's iou/filed_edges fields. Free prose mentioning the token IOU is OUT — a sieve demanding a referent from every such line would red the documentation for documenting.
The referent shape is one of: a repo-relative path that must exist, a shell command that must exit 0, a ticket id that must read PROVED, or the literal escape 'not expressible yet, because <X>'.
Compose cairn/machines/corrosion/constraint_set.json — it already declares this section and is already read by constraint_enforcement_holds. Do not build a parallel declared set.
